ValidationRule.description: Restricts creation/updation of CAP Diary Comment Type Interaction From Opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "CCRM_Interaction", NOT(ISBLANK( Opportunity__c)), ISBLANK(AccountId), ISPICKVAL( Category__c ,'CAP Diary Comments'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot create CAP Diary comment from Opportunity.
